description: Feature 3.7 limitation source registry — all limitations traceable to actual evidence

sampling.text: Curated Spotify-derived dataset — not a comprehensive sample of all music globally

popularity_definition.text: popularity is a Spotify platform engagement metric, not a universal measure of musical quality or commercial success

geographic_bias.text: Music from certain regions or markets may be over- or under-represented

model_type.text: XGBoost regression — predicts a continuous popularity score (0-100), not a probability

regression_not_classification.text: Output is a regression score — not a probability of being a hit
regression_not_classification.evidence: Limitations page: 'The model outputs a popularity score (0-100) — a regression output. This score is: Not a probability of a song being a hit'

performance_metrics.text: MAE/RMSE/R² describe model fit to training data, not prediction reliability for new songs
performance_metrics.evidence: Limitations page: 'These metrics describe model fit to the training data, not prediction reliability'

not_causal.text: Predictions reflect model behavior on training data — not causal relationships in the real world
not_causal.evidence: Limitations page warning: 'Correlational does not mean causal'

not_commercial_guarantee.text: Not a guarantee of commercial success
not_commercial_guarantee.evidence: Limitations page: 'Not a guarantee of commercial success'

academic_prototype.text: Student research prototype — not a production tool

not_causal.text: SHAP values show how the model weighed each feature — not that a feature causes popularity to change
not_causal.evidence: Limitations page: 'SHAP values do NOT establish: That a feature causes popularity to change'

model_behavior_only.text: SHAP values describe model behavior for a specific prediction — not real-world feature importance
model_behavior_only.evidence: openapi.json: 'IMPORTANT: SHAP values show feature importance, NOT causal relationships'

model_comparison_only.text: What-if shows how the model's prediction changes under modified inputs — not real-world causal effect
model_comparison_only.evidence: Limitations page: 'It does NOT show: How the actual popularity of a song would change'

no_real_world_effect.text: Use it to explore model behavior, not to plan production decisions

dataset_scope.text: Available dataset (1922–2019) — not a complete representation of global music industry
dataset_scope.evidence: USER_MANUAL.md §8: 'The available dataset shows 1922–2019 data from a curated Spotify-derived sample. It is not a comprehensive representation of all music globally.'

precomputed_not_live.text: Offline Demo Mode uses precomputed validated scenarios — not live model inference

limited_scenarios.text: Only precomputed examples are available offline — arbitrary new input may not be supported

no_sla.text: No SLA defined for response times — local demo environment only
no_sla.evidence: API_DOCUMENTATION.md: 'API response times are not guaranteed. No SLA is defined for the local demo environment.'

training_data_bias.text: Model may reflect and amplify biases present in the training data; historical popularity correlates with marketing, platform visibility

audio_features_insufficient.text: Audio features alone cannot capture artistic, cultural, or contextual factors that contribute to success
